explanation: Fast upward body hits thin wall 1, bounces to (-6.6,0.97), then slides along the side face of wide wall 0. With e=0 the impulse kills bounce but positional correction fails to hold the resting gap against sustained inward vx, so penetration grows from 0.131 at step 500 to 0.156 at step 504, exceeding the 0.15 limit. Restitution is not the cause (e=1 still fails); impact speed driving persistent sliding contact is.
